definitions.explanation: An integer that is not divisible by two, such as 1, 3, 5, 7, etc.

examples.japanese: {奇数|きすう}か{偶数|ぐうすう}かを{判定|はんてい}する。
examples.english: I determine whether it's an odd or even number.

examples.japanese: 3は{奇数|きすう}で、4は{偶数|ぐうすう}だ。
examples.english: 3 is an odd number, and 4 is an even number.

examples.japanese: {奇数|きすう}の{日|ひ}だけゴミを{出|だ}せる。
examples.english: Trash can only be put out on odd-numbered days.

notes:
ANTONYM:
・{偶数|ぐうすう} (even number)

MATH TERMS:
・{自然数|しぜんすう} (natural number)
・{整数|せいすう} (integer)
・{素数|そすう} (prime number)
